dct_creator_sm: Bertolo, Andrea (Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières, Centre de Recherche sur les Interactions Bassins Versants – Écosystèmes Aquatiques (RIVE), Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières, Trois-Rivières, Québec, Canada). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6018-816X
dct_description_sm: This data base is the one used in Gignac-Brassard et al (2022; Freshwat. Biol.) to analyse the relationship between different environmental variables (fish predation, temperature, resources, etc.) and the distribution of different zooplankton taxa in the water column in 17 boreal lakes.
dct_title_s: Data on Vertical distribution patterns of zooplankton across a gradient of fish predation in boreal lakes
